sections.title: From the Urban Hyena *to the Salty one*
body: Michele Warren opened The Urban Hyena on Hayne Avenue, then moved it to a larger space on Laurens Street.
Rather than leave the Hayne Avenue shop empty, she opened a second boutique there with a beach and surf theme: The Salty Hyena.
list: Sister shop: The Urban Hyena, Laurens Street

items.q: Is this the same shop as The Urban Hyena?
items.a: Same owner, different shop. The Urban Hyena is now on Laurens Street; The Salty Hyena took over its old space on Hayne Avenue.
A few men's pieces, alongside mostly women's wear and swimwear.
345 Hayne Avenue SW in downtown Aiken.

before: No website of its own: the shop appears only in local news and listings
Its sister shop's website still gives 345 Hayne Avenue as The Urban Hyena's address, which is now The Salty Hyena
The words on this concept come from WRDW and the Aiken Standard; photos, hours and new arrivals would come from the owner
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room for new arrivals and a link to The Urban Hyena, so each shop sends shoppers to the other
